result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban arterial road with a car-centric design characterized by large parking lots and minimal pedestrian protection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signalized crossings are present, the long crossing distances and lack of physical medians increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles in the adjacent lot and utility poles may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the sidewalk edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the parking lot

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signals, but is dominated by a wide multi-lane roadway. Faded crosswalk markings and the lack of a median refuge increase exposure for pedestrians crossing the arterial.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are worn, reducing visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalization, but suffers from degraded pavement and faded crosswalk markings. The commercial land use generates pedestrian activity, yet the wide roadway and lack of physical protection like medians increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street on the left side of the frame.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt in the intersection can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings using high-visibility continental patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and uneven patches, improving safety for all users.
